user_intent: Develop the same ordinary and second method across ATM and another EEG reconstruction host, including their combination.
primary_hosts: ATM semantic diffusion prior + h94 IP/Turbo
current_prototype_host: ATMS + direct h94 IP/Turbo; distinct from the full author ATM reconstruction pipeline.

common_parts.ordinary: A bounded condition-direction correction in each host native coordinates, fitted using that host frozen generation path.
common_parts.second_method: A candidate EEG-encoder training rule that preserves stimulus discrimination while improving downstream generator compatibility; current constrained response repair remains unconfirmed.
common_parts.weights: Fit host-specific parameters and normalization statistics; same algorithm does not imply sharing one checkpoint across incompatible feature spaces.

matrix_per_host.encoder: new-method encoder from the same parent

composition_rule: First test the same two fitted components independently and composed without extra tuning. Jointly retrained combinations, if later needed, are separate studies and cannot replace this four-cell result.
interaction: (ordinary_plus_new_method-ordinary)-(new_method-base); architectural separation is not evidence of additive gains.
parent_compatibility: Bind all four cells to exact parent/checkpoint/data identities. Historical ordinary trained for another parent cannot silently fill a matched cell. Preserve old ordinary; any newly matched head is separately saved.
host_adaptation_needed: native visual target and working coordinates
native condition/response path, including any frozen prior
host-specific encoder parameter selector, without ATMS name/count assumptions
actual gallery/query ordering and layer/time counts
native baseline sampler and inference information/cost
known_host_specific_assumptions_in_curre: 1323 concepts / 13230 examples / ten images per concept

evidence.HIVE_ordinary: reports/BRAINHIVE_FULL1654_ORIGINAL_ORDINARY_R80_RESULTS_20261101_v1.md; ten subjects R80 2000, native DINO gain supported; extra semantic gain over F-only/mean direction unconfirmed.
evidence.ATM_semantic_prior_ordinary: reports/ATM_NATIVE_ORDINARY_FULL400_RESULTS_20261103_v1.md; sub01 R4 400, SSIM gain supported, semantic advantage unconfirmed.
evidence.current_second_method: audit/GOAL_active_execution_handoff_20261106_v227.json; epoch6 training evidence only, full matched images pending.
evidence.baseline_code_scope: audit/crossdisciplinary_20261028_v1/baseline_author_source_scope_v228/audit.json; current ATMS source byte-identical to pinned author develop, not identical to old main.

execution_order: Complete ongoing sealed ATMS prototype and response-only control, all final images/metrics.
Use results to repair the common method definition and confirm efficacy against strong matched controls.
Bind compatible parents and host interfaces, then admit the same four-cell matrix on both primary hosts after finite resource checks.
scientific_permissions: Same allowed data/inference inputs, final checkpoints and within-host query/noise identity. Report different host costs; retain stronger encoder/continued-training/effective-update controls where relevant. Exposed benchmark remains exposed.
constraints: no scientific source changes to current running experiment
no untrained matrix cell reported as complete
